content: Drizzle workflow already established in packages/db/drizzle.config.ts (driver: 'expo', dialect: 'sqlite'). To add columns (bwFactor, entryMode on exercise; finishedAt/status + deletedAt on workout): edit schema.ts, run 'npx drizzle-kit generate' from packages/db, review the new numbered .sql file under drizzle/, commit it (append-only, never hand-edit generated files), then useMigrations() in apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx applies it automatically on next launch. SQLite ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN is supported directly (no table-recreation needed) as long as the new column has no non-constant default/not-null-without-default.
